summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that its insiders deposited $125,000 into the trust account for the second monthly extension of the deadline to complete a business combination, extending to March 23, 2027. The deposit follows shareholder approval of the extension amendment. No deal has been announced; the filing merely updates the trust account funding for the extension. This is a routine SPAC lifecycle event, not a special situation. Watch for continued monthly deposits or eventual business combination announcement.
